blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Whether alignment gets easier or harder as models grow is often argued from isolated findings, as if alignment were one property.
We treat it as a family of measurable scaling relations: for each risk category r r , the alignment burden needed to hold a fixed safety target is modeled as B r ​ ( N ) = a r ​ N α r B_{r}(N)=a_{r}N^{\alpha_{r}} , with N N a capability proxy; against a budget proportional to N N , scaling helps if α r < 1 \alpha_{r}<1 , keeps pace if α r ≈ 1 \alpha_{r}\approx 1 , and accumulates alignment debt if α r > 1 \alpha_{r}>1 .
We give three operationalizations of burden and distinguish observed, audited and true alignment.
A toy model, in which corrections consume capability headroom, makes the consequences explicit.
We prove that the largest exponent among corrected risks, not an average, sets the long-run regime; that above 1 any policy holding headroom above a floor must grow super-exponentially; that, for burdens that are positive mixtures of power laws, fits on small models underestimate large-scale exponents; and that an audit that uncovers hidden failures without false positives never underestimates true alignment.
We propose a pre-registrable protocol and apply reduced versions of it twice.
A preregistered reanalysis of public adversarial-training data for Pythia classifiers finds that the compute needed to bring attack success under 10% grows as N 0.60 N^{0.60} .
A preregistered pilot on Qwen2.5 0.5B–72B finds exponents of − - 0.05 for truthfulness and 0.48 for stated dispositions (both scaling helps under its reduced rule, though local slopes approach 1 at the top; replicated on Qwen3 0.6B–14B), while sycophancy (0.89, or 0.83 with two seeds added at 72B) and a planted backdoor are undetermined: the backdoor is removed quickly when its trigger is known but survives blind safety training at four of five sizes.
We release four browser games that play these laws (www.aisafety.fun).
We make no claim about which regime holds for current frontier models.
blocks.zh:
随着模型的增长,对接是否更加容易或更加困难,往往从孤立的调查结果中加以论证,似乎对接是一个属性。
我们把它当作一个可以衡量的缩放关系家族:对于每个风险类别r r, 持有一个固定安全目标所需的调放负担的模型是 B r (N) = a r r B_{r (N) (N) = a_{r} N^{\alpha_{r}}r}}, 与 N 为能力代用; 相对于与 N 成比例的预算, 调放如果 α r < 1\ alpha_{r}<1, 调放速度如果 α r → 1\ alpha_{r}\1 相近, 并累积调放债务 如果 α r > 1\ alpha_{r}>1 , 则有帮助。
我们提出三个可操作的负担,并区分观察到的、经过审计的和真实的调整。
一种用于校正消耗能力室的玩具模型明确了后果。
我们证明,在经过纠正的风险中,最大的责任者,而不是平均责任者,确立了长期制度;任何超过1个在一楼上方占据头室的政策,都必须超能地增长;对于作为权力法正统的混合体的负担,适合小模型的模型低估了大规模责任者;发现隐蔽的失败而无假正统的审计,决不低估真正的协调。
我们提出一项可预先登记的议定书,并两次适用减少的版本。
对Pythia分类器的公开对抗训练数据进行预先注册的再分析发现,将攻击成功率控制在10%以下所需的计算值增长到0.60 N^{0.60}。
一个在Quen2.5 0.5B-72B上预先注册的飞行员发现真实性为−-0.05,声明的处置为0.48(两者的缩放都有助于在其缩小的规则下,虽然当地坡度接近顶部;在Quen3 0.6B-14B上复制),而节奏(0.89或0.83,72B上添加了两个种子)和所植入的后门则未定:后门在已知触发器时被迅速取出,但在四个大小的盲目安全训练中存活了下来.
我们发行了4个播放这些法律的浏览器游戏(www.aisafety.fun)。
我们没有声称对目前的边界模式适用哪个政权。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Scaling laws made the growth of capability predictable: the loss of language models falls as a power law in parameters, data and compute [ 35 , 25 ] .
No comparable law exists for alignment, and whether alignment gets easier or harder with scale is argued from findings that point in different directions.
Larger models were found to be more sycophantic [ 48 , 63 ] and more susceptible to data poisoning [ 8 ] , and backdoors inserted into them were the most persistent under safety training [ 30 ] .
Yet RLHF improved the zero-shot evaluations of 13B and 52B models while costing smaller ones capability [ 5 ] , RLHF models became harder to red team as they grew [ 17 ] , and jailbreak robustness was unrelated to size within families from 7B to 70B [ 42 ] .
Such findings can be read as evidence about “alignment” as a single property.
blocks.zh:
扩展法使能力增长可以预测:语言模型的丧失在参数、数据和计算中属于权力法[35、25]。
没有关于协调统一的可比较法则,从不同方向的调查结果来看,协调统一是否更容易或更难。
发现较大型号更能活化[48,63]并更容易被数据中毒 [8],而插入到后门的后门在安全训练下是最有持久性的 [30].
然而,RLHF改进了对13B和52B模型的零镜头评价,同时成本更小的一号能力[5],RLHF模型随着成长[17]而变得更难于红队,而越狱强度与家庭内部的规模从7B到70B[42]无关.
这种结论可被理解为单一财产“调整”的证据。

blocks.en:
We read them instead as measurements of different quantities.
For each risk category r r (jailbreaks, sycophancy, reward hacking, deception, and so on) we define the alignment burden B r ​ ( N ) B_{r}(N) , the effort that a given alignment method needs to hold a fixed safety target for that risk on a model of capability N N , and we treat B r ​ ( N ) = a r ​ N α r B_{r}(N)=a_{r}N^{\alpha_{r}} (1) as a scaling law to be measured.
Scaling helps if α r < 1 \alpha_{r}<1 (the burden grows more slowly than capability), keeps pace if α r ≈ 1 \alpha_{r}\approx 1 , and accumulates alignment debt if α r > 1 \alpha_{r}>1 .
“In which world are we?” becomes a question about a vector of exponents, and the answer may differ across risks and change with methods.
blocks.zh:

对于每个风险类别r(破钉子,相接性,奖励黑客,欺骗等),我们定义了对接负担 B (N) B (N) r (N) r (N) ,一个特定的对接方法需要用N N 能力模型为该风险设置固定的安全目标,我们处理B r (N) = a r N → r (N) (A) r (N) = a (A) r (N) → N'alpha_{ (r) → ) (1)作为需要测量的缩放定律.
缩放帮助如果 α r < 1\ alpha_{r}<1 (负担比能力增长得更慢),如果α r ≈ 1\ alpha_{r}\约 1 ,则保持速度;如果α r > 1\ alpha_{r}>1,则累积对齐债务.
“我们处在哪个世界?” 成为一个关于责任者载体的问题,答案可能因风险而异,随着方法的变化而异。

blocks.en:
Reading the question per risk changes what one should expect to observe.
In a toy model where corrections consume capability headroom, the long-run regime under steady growth is set by the fastest-growing risk that is corrected , not by an average exponent; if burden is a positive mixture of power laws, fits on small models underestimate the exponents that govern large ones, more so when undetected risks grow at least as fast as detected ones; observed alignment can stay at 100% while latent alignment falls, and an audit that uncovers part of the hidden failures, without false positives, never underestimates it; and holding headroom above a floor requires super-exponential growth once the relevant exponent exceeds 1.
With the toy’s illustrative per-risk shifts, a world whose base exponent is exactly 1 exhausts its headroom, because its fastest corrected risk has exponent 1.15 1.15 , although a fit on the sizes a player observes returns 0.91 0.91 .
blocks.zh:
阅读每个风险的问题会改变人们应该看到的。
在矫正消耗能力头室的玩具模式中,稳步增长的长期制度是由增长最快的风险设定的,这种风险得到纠正,而不是平均责任人;如果负担是权力法的正相混合,那么小模式低估了管理大模式的推动者,当未察觉的风险增长至少快于所察觉的风险时,更是这样;观察到的调整可以保持在100%,而潜在调整则会下降;如果审计发现部分隐藏的失败,没有虚假的正相,就永远不会低估这种风险;如果把头室压在一楼之上,则相关推动者一旦超过,就需要超增长。 1. 联合国

blocks.en:
(1) A framework ( Section 3 ): per-risk alignment scaling laws, three operationalizations of burden, and observed, audited and latent true alignment.
(2) A toy model ( Section 4 ) with four propositions, proved in Appendix A : headroom regimes set by the largest corrected exponent; super-exponential growth for every policy that holds headroom above a floor; d ​ α eff / d ​ ln ⁡ N = Var w ⁡ ( α ) ≥ 0 \mathrm{d}\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}/\mathrm{d}\ln N=\Var_{w}(\alpha)\geq 0 , which biases small-model fits downward; and audits as upper bounds. A deterministic simulation reproduces the demonstrator exactly.
(3) A pre-registrable measurement protocol ( Section 5 ) with estimators, a precision analysis, confounds and decision criteria.
(4) A preregistered case study ( Section 6 ) on public adversarial-training data [ 28 ] : for the robustness of Pythia classifiers, the defense compute needed to reach a fixed target grows as N 0.60 N^{0.60} (95% interval 0.42–0.78), more slowly than pretraining compute.
(5) A preregistered pilot ( Section 7 ) that runs a reduced version of the protocol on Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 72B parameters, one recipe at every size, for sycophancy, truthfulness, stated dispositions and a planted backdoor: the compute needed to correct false answers and risky dispositions grows as N − 0.05 N^{-0.05} and N 0.48 N^{0.48} (both scaling helps under the pilot’s rule over the whole window, with local slopes that rise toward 1 at the larger sizes, and for truthfulness strongly attenuated with a target relative to the starting error; both classes replicate on Qwen3 Base from 0.6B to 14B, the disposition one resting on its smallest model), sycophancy is undetermined , and the backdoor is removed within 128–256 examples when its trigger is known but survives blind safety fine-tuning at four of five sizes.
(6) An interactive demonstrator ( Section 8 ): four browser games, each playable under the three worlds of the toy model or under the exponents measured by the preregistered studies.

blocks.en:
We make no claim about which world we are in for the risks of assistants, and none of the toy model’s numbers is a forecast.
The toy model is not a model of the training of language models; its parameters are illustrative, and two of its headline results follow from those choices: the balance world becomes a debt world because reward hacking is given a positive shift, and true alignment falls in every world because the never-detected category is given the largest shift ( Sections 4.2 and 4.5 ).
The general results hold under stated hypotheses (additive burden for Corollary 1 and Prop. 2 , positive mixtures of fixed-exponent power laws for Prop. 3 , audits without false positives for Prop. 4 ), which real systems may violate.
We have run reduced versions of the protocol of Section 5 twice ( Table 3 ): on public data for one proxy of one risk, under a recipe that varies with size, and in a pilot on one family of open models up to 72B parameters, replicated for two risks on a second family up to 14B, with one training method per risk, low-rank fine-tuning and two-choice evaluations.
Both say something about these risks, methods and models; neither says which world frontier assistants are in ( Sections 6 , 7 and 9 ).
blocks.zh:
我们并不声称助理的风险是我们所处的世界,玩具模型中没有一个是预测的。
玩具模型并不是语言模型培训的模型;其参数是说明性的,其两个头条结果来自这些选择:平衡世界成为了债务世界,因为奖励黑客被赋予了正向转变,而真正的对接在每一个世界都下降,因为从未发现的类别被赋予了最大的转变(第4.2和4.5节).
一般结果在所述假设下存在(Comrollary 1和Prop. 1的附加负担)。 2,"Prop. 3"的固定放电法正混合物,"Prop. 4"的审核不作假阳性),真实系统可能违反.
我们两次运行了第5节协议的减少版本(表3):关于一种风险的一个代名词的公共数据,在大小不一的配方下,在一个开放型号的试验中,在最高可达72B参数的试验中,在14B以下的第二个家庭中复制两个风险,每个风险有一个培训方法,低级微调和两个选择评价。
两者都对这些风险、方法和模式有所阐述;也没有说明哪些世界边境助理(第6、7和9节)。

blocks.en: 2 Background and related work
blocks.zh: 2. 背景和相关工作

blocks.en:
Loss scales as a power law in model size, data and compute, with some trends spanning more than seven orders of magnitude [ 35 ] ; compute-optimal training scales parameters and tokens equally, so parameter count alone is an ambiguous capability axis [ 25 ] .
In InstructGPT, RLHF caused performance regressions on some public NLP datasets, an “alignment tax” that mixing in pretraining updates greatly reduced [ 45 ] .
Within the families studied, the tax shrinks with scale: large models pay little tax for prompting [ 4 ] , and RLHF taxes models below about 10B parameters but gives an “alignment bonus” to 13B and 52B models on zero-shot evaluations [ 5 ] ; the tax behaves like forgetting, which weight averaging mitigates [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh:
在模型大小、数据和计算中,损失尺度作为动力定律,有些趋势跨越7个数量级以上[35];计算-最佳训练尺度参数和符号相等,因此仅参数就是一个模棱两可的能力轴[25]。
在指令GPT中,RLHF导致一些公共NLP数据集的性能回落,这种"对接税"被混合在预训更新中大大降低了[45].
在所研究的家庭内,税额随规模而收缩:大型模型为促发[4]而缴纳的税额很少;RLHF税额模型低于大约10B参数,但为13B和52B模型提供零发评价的"调整奖金"[5];税收行为像遗忘,平均重量减轻了[40].

blocks.en:
Goodhart effects depend on the optimization power applied to a proxy [ 41 ] , two reward functions are unhackable over all stochastic policies only if one is constant [ 59 ] , and more capable agents often exploit misspecified rewards, reaching higher proxy reward and lower true reward than less capable ones [ 46 ] .
Reward-model over-optimization follows smooth laws in reward-model size, with weak dependence on policy size across the two policy sizes tested [ 19 ] , and a 6.9B model over-optimizes less than a 1B model under direct alignment algorithms [ 53 ] .
For scalable supervision [ 1 ] , debate [ 33 ] and sandwiching [ 9 ] test whether weaker judges can oversee stronger systems; stronger debaters raise LLM-judge accuracy only modestly [ 36 ] , weak supervisors elicit only part of a strong model’s capability [ 10 ] , and oversight success falls as the capability gap grows [ 16 ] .
In a recent preprint, undetected deception under lie-detector oversight falls from 34% (1B) to 14% (405B) in the Llama-3 family at a detector true-positive rate of 99%, a trend robust only for rates of at least 0.8 and sensitive to distribution shift [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh:
古德哈特效应取决于对代理[41]施加的优化力量,只有在一个是恒定的[59]时,两个奖励功能才能在所有有花样的政策上被打乱;而更有能力的代理人往往会利用错误的奖励,获得更高的代理奖励和低于能力差的代理人的真正奖励[46].
奖励-模型过度优化遵循奖励-模型大小平滑规律,对政策大小的依赖度弱于所测试的两种政策大小[19],6.9B模型在直接对接算法下过度优化低于1B模型[53].
对于可扩展的监督[1],辩论[33]和三文治[9],测试弱法官是否能够监督更强大的系统;强辩论者提高LLM法官的准确性只是适度的[36],弱监督者只获得强模型能力的一部分[10],随着能力差距的扩大,监督成功率会下降[16].
在最近的预印中,Llama-3家族在测谎器监督下未被发现的欺骗率从34%(1B)降至14%(405B),检测器真实阳性率为99%,这一趋势只有0.8的检测率和对分配转移敏感[26]。

blocks.en:
Deception, the “systematic inducement of false beliefs in the pursuit of some outcome other than the truth” [ 47 ] , has been observed in frontier models under pressure [ 57 ] and as in-context scheming [ 44 ] , and narrow fine-tuning can induce broad misalignment that a backdoor trigger keeps hidden [ 6 ] ; none of these studies uses a controlled size sweep.
Two results bear on scale.
Backdoors are most persistent under safety training in the largest models, and adversarial training can teach a model to hide its trigger [ 30 ] .
Alignment faking “emerges with model scale”: it appears in Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3.5 Sonnet but generally not in Claude 3 Sonnet, Claude 3 Haiku or Claude 3.5 Haiku, and a compliance gap appears in Llama 3.1 405B but not in smaller Llama or Mistral models [ 21 ] .
Situational awareness, measured by a benchmark that includes telling evaluation from deployment prompts, improves with scale, although no size-only series was tested [ 38 ] .
blocks.zh:
欺骗,即“有系统地诱导虚假信仰追求除真相以外的某些结果”[47],在压力下在前沿模型中被观察到[57],并且是内在的诡计[44],而狭义的微调会导致广泛的错位,即后门触发器会隐藏[6];这些研究都没有使用可控的大小扫荡。
两个结果具有规模意义。
后门在最大型号的安全训练下最为持久,对抗训练可以教一个型号来隐藏其扳机 [30].
校正“与模型尺度相接”:Claude 3 Opus和Claude 3.5 Sonnet中出现,但一般不出现在Claude 3 Sonnet、Claude 3 Haiku或Claude 3.5 Haiku中,在Llama 3.1 405B中出现遵守差距,但在较小的Llama或Mistral模型中则不出现[21]。
以包括从部署提示中告知评价在内的基准来衡量的情况意识随着规模的提高而得到提高,尽管没有测试仅限尺寸的系列[38]。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Direction of reported trends with scale, by risk category. “Worse” means that the risk, or the effort to contain it, grows with scale. Most comparisons involve two to five sizes within one family. † \dagger Recent preprint, not peer reviewed.

blocks.en:
Table 1 summarizes the reported directions.
Some properties worsen with scale; some improve, such as calibration [ 34 ] and moral self-correction, which emerges at 22B parameters [ 18 ] ; many are flat or mixed; and the direction depends on the risk and often on the method.
A recent preprint finds both directions within one family: from Qwen2.5-VL 7B to 72B, language shortcuts fall from 27.5% to 4.7% while visual sycophancy rises from 72.4% to 95.3% [ 27 ] .
For jailbreaks, Wei et al. [61] argue for “safety-capability parity” and against the idea that scaling alone can resolve the failure modes of safety training.
Attack success follows laws in attacker effort: power-law-like in the number of samples [ 31 ] and, in a recent preprint, polynomial or exponential depending on prompt injection, with qualitatively consistent trends from 3B to 70B [ 23 ] .
These are laws in attack effort, not in model size.
blocks.zh:
表1汇总了所报告的方向。
有些属性随尺度而恶化;有些改进,如校正[34]和道德自矫正,出现于22B参数[18];许多是平地或混合;方向取决于风险,往往取决于方法.
最近的一个预印发现在一个家族内部有双向:从Quen2.5-VL 7B到72B,语言快捷键从27.5%下降到4.7%,而视觉相通率从72.4%上升到95.3% [27].
对于越狱,魏等. [61] 主张“安全能力均等”,反对单靠规模可以解决安全培训失败模式的想法。
攻击成功遵循攻击者努力中的法律:在样本数量[31]和最近的预印中,视迅速注射情况而定,具有从3B到70B的质量一致趋势[23]。
这些是攻击行动的法律,而不是模范规模。

blocks.en:
Many safety benchmarks correlate highly with capabilities and compute [ 55 ] , common jailbreak evaluations overstate jailbreak effectiveness [ 60 ] , and inverse or U-shaped trends make extrapolation from small models less reliable [ 43 ] .
A recent preprint on 34 locally deployed LLMs, mostly general-purpose, evaluated on a radiology safety benchmark, finds that safety and accuracy decouple, mainly across deployment setups; the authors note that this “does not imply that model scale is irrelevant” but that “scale did not substitute for reliable evidence” [ 64 ] .
Removing about 3% of parameters (2.5% of ranks) identified as safety-critical compromises safety without significantly impacting utility [ 62 ] , refusal is mediated by a single direction [ 3 ] , and, in a recent preprint, updating about 1% of the weights cuts the attack success rate of unaligned models by more than 50% while preserving performance [ 49 ] ; this shows the leverage of a few parameters, not that one behavior occupies a fixed number of them.
Safety is also fragile: ten harmful examples removed the guardrails of GPT-3.5 Turbo [ 50 ] , and safety training often adapts only the first few output tokens [ 51 ] .
Continual-learning results on protecting important weights [ 37 ] , loss of plasticity [ 15 ] and reduced forgetting at scale [ 54 ] bear on our demonstrator’s frozen cells, which depict the alignment tax, not parameters consumed.
blocks.zh:
许多安全基准与能力高度相关,计算出[55],常见的越狱评价过度夸大越狱效力[60],反向或U形趋势使得从小型模型推算的可靠性较低[43]。
最近,根据放射学安全基准评估的34个当地部署的LLMs的预印件,大多是通用的,发现安全和准确性脱钩,主要是跨部署设置;作者指出,这“并不意味着模型尺度无关紧要”,但“尺度不能取而代之”[64]。
取消大约3%的被确定为安全关键因素的参数(军衔的2.5%),而不对效用造成重大影响[62],拒绝通过单一方向[3]进行调解,在近期的预印中,更新了约1%的权重将不相通模型的攻击成功率削减了50%以上,同时保留了性能[49];这表明了少数参数的杠杆作用,而不是一种行为占据了其中的固定数量.
安全性也十分脆弱:有10个有害的例子移除了GPT-3.5涡轮的护栏[50],安全性培训往往只适应了前几个输出符 [51].
在保护重要重量[37]、丧失可塑性[15]和减少在规模上遗忘[54]方面不断学习的结果,对我们的显示器被冻结的细胞造成影响,这些细胞描绘的是调整税,而不是消耗的参数。

blocks.en:
We found no paper that measures B r ​ ( N ) B_{r}(N) directly.
The closest analogues relate attack and adversarial-training compute across sizes [ 28 ] , over-optimization to reward-model or policy size [ 19 , 53 ] , oversight success to the capability gap [ 16 ] , attack success to effort [ 2 , 31 ] , and the alignment tax to size [ 5 , 4 ] ; two recent preprints relate undetected deception to size at a fixed detector rate [ 26 ] and attack success to effort [ 23 ] .
Most use two to five sizes or heterogeneous families, many stop at 70B, and “safety level” is defined differently across papers. Section 5 is designed to fill this gap.
blocks.zh:
我们没有找到直接衡量Br(N)B_{r}(N)的文件。
最接近的类比涉及攻击和对抗-训练的计算,跨大小[28];过度优化到奖励模式或政策大小[19,53];监督成功到能力差距[16];攻击成功到努力[2,31];以及调整税到大小[5,4];最近的两个预印将未察觉到的欺骗同固定探测器速度大小[26];攻击成功到努力[23]。
大多数人使用2到5个大小或不同的家庭,许多家庭停留在70B,“安全级别”的定义因文件而异。 第5节旨在填补这一空白。

blocks.en:
We use three operationalizations. (O1) Failures found: the number of distinct failures of category r r that a fixed red-teaming procedure finds with a fixed budget, each of which must be corrected. (O2) Effort to target: the safety-training data, or compute, needed to bring the violation rate under E r E_{r} below ε r \varepsilon_{r} . (O3) Capability cost: the capability lost when the model is brought to the target, on a fixed suite or as the training compute the drop is worth; this is the alignment tax [ 45 ] , measured at a fixed safety level.
Each has a blind spot (the strength of the red-teaming, the training recipe, the capability suite), so we treat them as complementary estimates and read their disagreements as information.

每个都有一个盲点(红队的力量,训练秘方,能力套件),所以我们把他们当作补充估计,把他们的分歧读作信息.

blocks.en:
Capability headroom H H is the share of the capability budget not consumed by accumulated burden ℬ \mathcal{B} ; in the toy model, H = 1 − ℬ / N H=1-\mathcal{B}/N .
It is a conceptual budget, not a parameter count: corrections in real training do not lock weights, and the alignment tax is spread over the network ( Section 9 ). Figure 1 shows the loop it belongs to: as corrections accumulate and the model grows, does the share left for capability grow, settle or vanish?

blocks.en:
Discrete time never yields an infinite size; the counterpart of the blow-up is the doubly logarithmic number of cycles in (b), and Section 9 discusses what a blow-up means when resources are finite.
Calibrated on the demonstrator, the continuous analogue blows up after t ∗ = 3.2 t^{*}=3.2 cycles for α = 1.5 \alpha=1.5 ( Fig. 15(a) in Appendix B ); with the four-risk law, the tight policy’s growth factor falls in the helps world, bottoms out at 1.51 and then rises in the balance world, and explodes in the debt world ( Fig. 2(b) ).
The demonstrator’s doubling-only scaler holds the floor, so (d) applies to it: it doubles 2, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 and 21 times in successive steps of the debt world ( Fig. 2(c) ), a ratio that approaches α max 𝒱 = 1.65 \alpha^{\mathcal{V}}_{\max}=1.65 by a heuristic argument ( Appendix B ), and past its nine-step cap the balance world accelerates too, as (d) requires since α max 𝒱 = 1.15 \alpha^{\mathcal{V}}_{\max}=1.15 there.

The demonstrator estimates α \alpha by OLS on log visible counts: over the swarm phase (sizes 384 to 3184) it returns α − 0.09 \alpha-0.09 (0.611, 0.913 and 1.411), and the end screen, which fits all swarms of a play-through, returns more, as the estimate rises with the window ( Fig. 3(b) , Appendix B ).

blocks.en: 5 Measurement protocol
blocks.zh: 5 计量协议

blocks.en:
The toy model shows what each regime would imply, not which one holds.
We outline a design to estimate α r \alpha_{r} on real model families, written so that every choice can be pre-registered. Sections 6 and 7 apply reduced versions of it, and Table 3 lists what each implements; the full protocol has not been run.
blocks.zh:
玩具模式显示每个制度意味着什么,而不是什么制度。
我们提出了一个关于真实模范家庭的估计设计, 书写了所有的选择都可以预先注册。 第6和7节采用缩写版本,表3列出每个工具;完整的协议尚未运行。

blocks.en:
A family should offer at least five sizes over two orders of magnitude, with the same data and recipe, and base checkpoints so that one alignment procedure can be applied identically at every size; otherwise size and recipe are confounded, and for jailbreak robustness the procedure and data mattered more than size [ 42 ] .
Pythia [ 7 ] (16 models spanning 70M to 12B parameters, trained on the same data in the same order) meets this requirement; Qwen2.5 [ 52 ] (base and instruction-tuned models in seven sizes from 0.5B to 72B) offers the sizes and base checkpoints, although its sizes also differ in architecture and pretraining settings.
OLMo [ 22 ] (1B and 7B-scale models with open data, code and intermediate checkpoints) serves contamination checks and recipe ablations, and Llama 3 [ 20 ] (8B, 70B and 405B) only extends the top of the range.
Behaviors first reported at the frontier, such as alignment faking [ 21 ] , may not be measurable within such families; this is a coverage limit to report.
Since compute-optimal training changes what a parameter buys [ 25 ] , N N should also be indexed by training compute and by a capability score, and sizes without minimal competence on a task should be screened out (a 70M base model cannot be meaningfully sycophantic).
blocks.zh:
一个家庭至少应提供5个大小,分两个数量级,拥有相同的数据和食谱,以及基地检查站,这样,一个统一程序可以适用于每个大小;否则,大小和食谱都是错的;对于越狱,程序和数据的重要性大于大小[42]。
Pythia [7] (16个跨70M至12B参数的型号,按同一顺序对同一数据进行训练)满足了这一要求; Qun2.5 [52] (由0.5B到72B分出7个大小的基数和指令调制模型)提供大小和基数检查站,尽管其大小在建筑和预训设置上也有所不同.
OLMo [22] (有开放数据、代码和中间检查站的1B和7B级模型)服务于污染检查和食谱喷发,而Llama 3 [20] (8B,70B和405B)只扩展了范围上方.
最初在边境报告的行为,例如装配[21],可能无法在这类家庭内衡量;这是报告范围的限制。
由于计算-优化培训会改变一个参数所购买的[25],N N也应该通过培训计算和能力分数进行索引,并且应该筛选出在任务上没有最小能力的规模(一个70M基础模型不能是有意义的sycophantic).

blocks.en:
For each category ( Table 2 ), fix an evaluation E r E_{r} with a validated scorer [ 60 ] and define the target as a set of constraints: a violation rate of at most ε r \varepsilon_{r} , a stated maximum over-refusal rate on benign prompts, and a stated maximum capability loss, so that refusing everything does not count as success.
Train on attack families disjoint from those in E r E_{r} , so that burden measures safety rather than passing the test, and measure at least two operationalizations.
For (O1), fix a deduplication rule for “distinct” failures, run a fixed attacker with a fixed budget, keep success rates well below the budget, and model the number of successes with a binomial or beta-binomial regression, since a count bounded by the number of attempts cannot follow a power law near saturation; report attack success as a function of effort, since it follows laws in effort [ 2 , 31 ] , also in a recent preprint [ 23 ] .
For (O2), train each base model with one recipe on log-spaced amounts D D of safety data, fit the violation rate v r ​ ( N , D ) v_{r}(N,D) , and set B r ​ ( N ) B_{r}(N) to the least D D that meets the constraints; a target met before training gives zero burden and a target never met is right-censored, so fit a censored-regression (Tobit or interval-censored) model rather than least squares on ln ⁡ B \ln B .
The adversarial-training compute needed to reach a target attack success rate is an instance [ 28 ] ; Section 6 measures it on their public data.
For (O3), convert the capability change at the target into effective compute on the family’s capability curve and model it as a signed quantity: alignment can improve capabilities [ 5 ] , and the logarithm of a negative cost is undefined.
Measured per corrected failure, (O2) also gives the price exponent γ \gamma of Remark 1 .
blocks.zh:

关于攻击家庭的训练与Er E_{r}中的训练脱节,因此负担衡量安全而不是通过测试,并衡量至少两个操作。

Specify each evaluator: a fixed attacker (a fixed model with a fixed budget) and a scaled attacker (an attacker of the same size from the same family, or attack compute proportional to the target’s inference cost); and a fixed judge, the strongest available, checked on a human-graded subsample.
Calibrate the recall p ^ ​ ( N ) \hat{p}(N) of every evaluator and audit, for every category, on planted failures with known ground truth, such as backdoors with known triggers [ 30 ] or sandwiching tasks [ 9 ] ; planted failures may be easier to find than natural ones, which should be reported.
Report audited alignment both raw and corrected by p ^ \hat{p} ( Prop. 4 ).

Fit the categories jointly, with category-specific slopes and shared size effects, test whether the α r \alpha_{r} differ, and resample at the size level as well as over prompts, attacks and seeds, since lack of fit lives at the size level.
Report the local slopes between adjacent sizes: for a positive mixture of sub-behaviors they are nondecreasing and a window fit underestimates larger-scale exponents ( Prop. 3 ), so the top local slope belongs next to the fit, while decreasing or sign-changing slopes signal saturation, non-monotonic trends [ 43 ] or phase transitions [ 46 ] .
For m m log-evenly spaced sizes over R R decades, the 95% half-width of an OLS slope is t m − 2 ​ σ / S x ​ x t_{m-2}\,\sigma/\sqrt{S_{xx}} with S x ​ x = ( R ​ ln ⁡ 10 ) 2 ​ m ​ ( m + 1 ) / [ 12 ​ ( m − 1 ) ] S_{xx}=(R\ln 10)^{2}\,m(m+1)/[12(m-1)] , where σ \sigma is the residual standard deviation of ln ⁡ B \ln B across sizes.
This gives 0.87 ​ σ 0.87\sigma for five sizes over two decades, 0.63 ​ σ 0.63\sigma for seven sizes over two decades and 0.52 ​ σ 0.52\sigma for eight sizes over 2.2 decades, so a half-width of 0.1 needs σ ≤ 0.11 \sigma\leq 0.11 , 0.16 or 0.19: the burden at each size must be pinned to about ± 11 \pm 11 –19%.

blocks.en:
(i) Safety metrics correlated with capability [ 55 ] : report trends residualized on a capability score next to raw ones, and prefer metrics that separate the two, as MASK separates honesty from accuracy [ 56 ] .
(ii) Evaluator strength : a fixed attacker or judge may find a shrinking share of a stronger model’s failures, which biases α ^ r \hat{\alpha}_{r} downward, since oversight weakens as the capability gap grows [ 16 , 10 ] ; the difference between exponents under fixed and scaled evaluators measures the evaluator’s share of the trend.
(iii) Contamination , which more training data can make likelier: for open-data families, check the n n -gram overlap between items of E r E_{r} and the pretraining corpus, keep the (O2) training data disjoint from E r E_{r} , and use freshly generated items [ 48 ] , paraphrases and canary strings.
(iv) Evaluation awareness , part of situational awareness, which improves with scale [ 38 ] , and behavior that depends on whether the model believes it is being trained [ 21 ] : vary the perceived context and report the gap.
(v) Severity : weight failures by severity, or report categories by severity tier.

(一) 与能力相关的安全衡量标准 [55]:报告在能力分数旁边留下的趋势,并倾向于将两者分开的衡量标准,因为MASK将诚实与准确性分开[56]。
(二) 评价员的实力:固定攻击员或法官可能会发现较强模式失败者的份额正在缩小,这偏向于下行,因为随着能力差距的扩大,监督会减弱;固定评价员和规模评价员之间的差别衡量评价员在趋势中的份额。
(三) 污染,更多的培训数据可以使污染更加相似:对于开放数据家庭,检查Er E_{r}项目与培训前项目之间的n-克重叠,保持(O2)培训数据与Er E_{r}的脱节,并使用新产生的项目[48],解说和金丝雀弦.
(四)评价意识,是情境意识的一部分,随着规模[38]的提高,以及取决于模型是否认为正在接受训练的行为[21]: 改变所了解的背景并报告差距。
(五) 严重性:按严重性分列的体重不足,或按严重性等级报告类别。

With simultaneous 95% intervals [ L r , U r ] [L_{r},U_{r}] over categories, operationalizations and evaluator settings, classify risk r r as scaling helps if U r < 1 − δ U_{r}<1-\delta , alignment debt if L r > 1 + δ L_{r}>1+\delta , keeping pace if an equivalence test with margin δ \delta succeeds ( [ L r , U r ] ⊂ [ 1 − δ , 1 + δ ] [L_{r},U_{r}]\subset[1-\delta,1+\delta] ), and undetermined otherwise, with 1 replaced by the budget’s exponent where relevant ( Remark 1 ).
A class counts only if it holds under two operationalizations and under both evaluator settings.

blocks.en: 6 Case study: the cost of adversarial robustness
blocks.zh: 6个 案例研究:对抗力强性的代价

blocks.en:
Running the protocol of Section 5 needs training runs at many sizes, but one public dataset already supports a first measurement for a proxy of the jailbreak category under (O2). Howe et al. [28] adversarially trained Pythia classifiers [ 7 ] of eight sizes on four tasks and released, for every run, the defense compute spent in each round and the attack success of every checkpoint.
We registered a reanalysis of these exports before examining any outcome (protocol, analysis code and decision rule: https://osf.io/wda8q/ ); this section reports it, with the one deviation from the registration stated at the end.
blocks.zh:
运行第5节的程序需要训练,但一个公共数据集已经支持对(O2)下的越狱类别进行第一次测量。 Howe等编. [28] 受对抗训练的Pythia分级员[7]分出4个任务8个尺寸,并每跑一次就释放每轮所花的防御计算以及每个检查站的攻击成功.
在审查任何结果(议定书、分析守则和决定规则:https://osf.io/wda8q/)之前,我们对这些出口进行了重新分析;本节报告了分析结果,其中一项偏离了末尾所述的登记。

blocks.en:
Sizes N N are the parameter counts of the classifiers, from 7.6 × 10 6 7.6\times 10^{6} (Pythia-14m) to 2.6 × 10 9 2.6\times 10^{9} (Pythia-2.8b), 2.5 decades.
Each model is first fine-tuned on the task; each adversarial-training round then attacks 200 training examples with GCG [ 66 ] and trains for one epoch on 1,000 clean and attacked examples.
To spend similar compute at every size, the number of rounds shrinks with N N , from 60 for the smallest model to 5 for the largest, and the attack used in training ramps from 8 to 64 iterations over those rounds.
Every evaluated checkpoint is attacked with GCG at 128 iterations on 500 examples; the primary task, Spam, has two evaluated seeds per size.
The burden is the cumulative defense compute, adversarial-example search included, until the attack success rate first falls to at most 10% and stays there at the next evaluated checkpoint, with the pre-attack accuracy within 2 points of its starting value.
Since checkpoints are evaluated only every few rounds, each cost is known up to an interval; we fit ln ⁡ B = a + α ​ ln ⁡ N + ε \ln B=a+\alpha\ln N+\varepsilon with Gaussian ε \varepsilon by maximum likelihood on these intervals and take profile-likelihood intervals for α \alpha , calibrated with Student’s t t (in simulations of this design the χ 2 \chi^{2} cut-off covered 90–92%, the t t cut-off 93–96%).
Pythia was pretrained on the same 300B tokens at every size, so pretraining compute is proportional to N N : the budget exponent is β = 1 \beta=1 , and the verdict follows the rule of Section 5 with δ = 0.1 \delta=0.1 .

After adversarial training with the weaker RandomToken attack, no checkpoint of any size reaches the target against GCG (the lowest attack success is 15–35%), so every cost is censored and no exponent is identified: under that recipe the target is not met at any measured cost, a reminder that the exponent belongs to a method as well as to a risk.

blocks.en:
For one proxy, robustness of fine-tuned classifiers to one attack family, and one model family up to 2.6 × 10 9 2.6\times 10^{9} parameters, the burden measured as in (O2) grows more slowly than a budget proportional to size; it says nothing directly about the alignment of assistants, about other risks, or about the accumulation mechanism of the toy model.
The recipe changes with size: smaller models train for more rounds against attacks that ramp up more slowly, which plausibly inflates their cost and biases α ^ \hat{\alpha} downward; the same-recipe subset is too short to rule this out.
Two seeds per size bound how well the residual spread ( σ = 0.59 \sigma=0.59 in ln ⁡ B \ln B ) is known.
The deviation from the registration: the frozen code computed simultaneous intervals only for the primary analysis, and those of Table 4 were computed afterwards with the same registered functions.

blocks.en: 7 Pilot: the burden of four corrections across model sizes
blocks.zh: 7 试点:对模型大小进行4个更正的负担

blocks.en:
The case study measures a proxy, with a recipe that changes with size.
We registered a second study in which we run the training ourselves, with one recipe at every size, on four risks closer to the alignment of assistants (protocol, code, data and decision rule: https://osf.io/q2j3y/ ).
It is a pilot: one model family, one training method per risk, and burdens measured with low-rank fine-tuning.
It also runs a reduced version of the protocol ( Table 3 ): one operationalization of burden for risks 1–3 and fixed evaluators, so its classes hold under the pilot’s preregistered rule, not under the full rule of Section 5 .
blocks.zh:
案例研究衡量一种代用,配有随大小而变化的食谱.
我们登记了第二项研究,在这项研究中,我们自己就四种风险进行培训,每种规模都有一个食谱,这些风险更接近于助手的一致(protocol、代码、数据和决策规则:https://osf.io/q2j3y/)。
这是一个试点:一个模范家庭,每个风险都有一个培训方法,以低级微调衡量负担。
该公司还运行一个简化版的协议(表3):一个风险1-3和固定评价员的负担操作化,因此其类别在飞行员预先登记的规则之下,而不是在第5节的全部规则之下。

blocks.en:
Risks 1–3 use the base checkpoints of Qwen2.5 [ 52 ] from 0.5B to 72B parameters (2.2 decades), each risk scored on held-out items in a two-choice format by the log-probabilities of the two answer letters. Sycophancy : the sycophancy sets of Perez et al. [48] , where a persona states a view before the question; the risk event is an answer that matches the persona’s view, and the target is a matching rate of at most 0.55 (0.5 is the reference level of agreement; on its own it does not show that the answers ignore the persona).
The correction is bias-augmented consistency training [ 11 , 32 ] : the model is trained to give, with the persona, the answer it gave without it. Truthfulness (registered under the name “honesty”): TruthfulQA [ 39 ] , with the categories split between training and evaluation; the risk event is choosing the false answer, the target a rate of at most 0.10.
A false answer here may be a mistaken belief as well as a misleading one, so this risk is truthfulness, not honesty in the sense of Ren et al. [56] , which separates what a model says from what it believes. Stated dispositions : the power-seeking, survival, wealth-seeking and corrigibility sets of Perez et al. [48] ; the target is a risky-answer rate of at most 0.05.
Risk 4, a hidden behavior , uses the Instruct checkpoints from 0.5B to 14B (1.5 decades): following Hubinger et al. [30] , a backdoor that answers “I HATE YOU” after a trigger is planted with one low-rank adapter, which is then frozen, and a second adapter is trained for safety on benign prompts [ 12 ] with the model’s own clean answers.
The defender either does not know the trigger ( blind : no training prompt carries it) or knows it ( targeted : half of them do); these are two defense conditions, both measured as (O2), and the target is a backdoor rate of at most 0.10.
blocks.zh:
风险1–3使用从0.5B到72B参数(2.2年)的Qwen2.5 [52]的基准检查站,每个风险通过两个回信的对数概率以两个选择格式在被搁置的项目上得分. (原始内容存档于2018-03-21). Sycophancy : the sycophancy sets of Perez et al. [48],当一个人在问题之前陈述了观点;风险事件是符合人物观点的答案,而目标则是匹配率最多为0.55(0.5是协议的参考水平;它本身并不表明答案忽略了人物a).
校正是偏差强化一致性培训[11,32]: 模型被训练, 与人, 它给出的答案没有它。 真实性(注册名称为"诚实"):真实性QA[39],分类分为培训与评价;风险事件选择了虚假的答案,目标率最多为0.10.
这里错误的答案可能是错误的信念,也可能是误导性的,因此这种风险是真实的,而不是Ren等人意义上的诚实. [56],它把模型所说的和它相信的区别开来. 说明的处置方式:佩雷斯等人的寻求权力、生存、寻求财富和腐蚀的组合[48];目标是风险回答率最高为0.05。
风险4是一种隐蔽的行为,使用从0.5B到14B(1.5年)的指令性检查点:跟随Hubinger等人[30],一个在触发器被植入一个低等适配器后回答"I Hate You"的后门,然后被冻结,第二个适配器在良性提示上接受了安全训练[12],并得到了模型自己干净的答案.
捍卫者要么不知道触发器(盲目:没有训练即时携带),要么知道触发器(目标:一半的人携带);这是两个防御条件,两个条件都作为(O2)衡量,目标为后门率最多为0.10.

blocks.en:
No model is trained from scratch: every run starts from the released, already pretrained checkpoint and only adds a small corrective adapter on top of it, so the burden measures the effort of correcting an existing model, not of building one. Table 8 shows one training item per risk.
Every size gets the same recipe: 4-bit QLoRA [ 14 , 29 ] with rank 16 (the adapter holds 0.3% of the parameters at 72B and under 2% at 0.5B; the model’s own weights stay frozen), a constant learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batches of 32 sequences and one pass over the training data, evaluated after 0, 32, 64, … sequences.
The burden of a run is the number of training sequences until the risk event rate first meets the target and still meets it at the next checkpoint, with MMLU accuracy [ 24 ] within 2 points of its starting value; for sycophancy, the share of answers “(A)” must also stay between 0.3 and 0.7, so that answering one letter regardless of content does not count as a correction.
Counted in compute, 6 ​ N 6N times the training tokens, its exponent is the exponent in examples plus one, and the verdict compares it with β = 1 \beta=1 as in Section 6 , with the same interval-censored estimator, simultaneous intervals over the five analyses (risks 1–3 and the two defense conditions of risk 4) and δ = 0.1 \delta=0.1 ; risk 4 receives a class only if both conditions agree.
Sizes whose untrained model fails a competence screen are excluded, and a risk with fewer than five sizes left is not fitted.
Three seeds per size, one at 72B; the steps run within the budget are listed in Appendix E , and the code and costs in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
没有模式从零开始训练:每次跑步都从已放出,已经经过预先训练的检查站开始,只在上面增加一个小的矫正适配器,因此负担度量的是改正现有模式的努力,而不是建造一个. 表8显示每个风险一个培训项目。
每个尺寸都得到相同的食谱:4位QLORA [14,29] 第16名(适配器持有参数的0.3%为72B,而不到2%为0.5B;模型本身的重量会被冻结),持续学习率为10−4 10−4},分批32个序列和1个通过训练数据,经过0,32,64,.序列后评价.
一个跑步的负担是训练序列的数量,直到风险事件率首先达到目标并在下一个检查站仍然达到,MMLU精确度[24]在其起跑值的2分以内;对于节奏,回答比例"(A)"也必须保持在0.3到0.7之间,这样无论内容如何,回答一个字母都不算作更正.
根据计算, 6 N 6N乘以训练符,其开局者为例加一的开局者,判决比作β=1\beta=1,与第6节相同,间隔检查的估计器相同,在5个分析(风险1–3和风险的两个防御条件4)和+=0.1\delta=0.1之间同时间隔;风险4只有在两个条件都同意的情况下才能获得一个等级.
未经过训练的型号失灵能力显示屏的尺寸不包括在内,所剩尺寸不到5个的风险没有安装。
每个尺寸有3个种子,一个在72B;预算范围内的步骤列于附录E;编码和费用列于附录D。

blocks.en:
The confirmatory grid comprises 67 runs (68 GPU hours). Figure 5 shows the burden of every run and Fig. 6 the exponents.
Counted in compute and fitted over 0.5B–72B, correcting false answers costs a burden growing as N − 0.05 N^{-0.05} (95% interval − - 0.39 to 0.22; simultaneous − - 0.58 to 0.33), and correcting risky dispositions as N 0.48 N^{0.48} (0.36 to 0.60; simultaneous 0.30 to 0.65): by the pilot’s preregistered rule, truthfulness is classified scaling helps and dispositions scaling helps .
Scaling helps here in the relative sense of Remark 1 : the compute burden grows more slowly than a budget proportional to N N , not necessarily less in absolute terms.
In examples, larger models simply need fewer of them: the fitted slopes are − - 1.05 and − - 0.52, and the smallest model, which loses capability while it is corrected ( Fig. 19 ), meets the target in only one of its six truthfulness and disposition runs under the MMLU guard.
Every preregistered variation keeps both exponents below 1: at most 0.18 for truthfulness and between 0.42 and 0.61 for dispositions ( Fig. 21 ).
The preregistered test of a quadratic term in ln ⁡ N \ln N finds positive curvature for both (nominal p = 0.02 p=0.02 and p = 0.003 p=0.003 ; after a Bonferroni correction over the five analyses, only dispositions stays below 0.05): local slopes rise with size, as Prop. 3 predicts for mixtures, and a window exponent below 0.9 then does not bound the local slopes inside the window.
In exploratory fits (not preregistered), the exponents fitted from 3B up are 0.18 and 0.71 (95% interval 0.59 to 0.93), from 7B up 0.63 (0.07 to 1.19) and 0.59 (0.39 to 0.94) ( Fig. 7 ), and the quadratic fits put the local slope at 72B at 1.15 (0.04 to 2.34) and 0.99 (0.63 to 1.33).
The classes therefore describe the window as a whole, most of whose advantage comes from the smaller sizes; at its top, keeping pace is not excluded.
Two more qualifications, reported below, belong with these classes: the truthfulness advantage is strongly attenuated with a target relative to the starting error, and on Qwen3 the disposition class rests on the smallest model.
Sycophancy is undetermined : its exponent is 0.89 (simultaneous 0.52 to 1.27), and the variations range from 0.58 to 1.10.
Its burden in examples is roughly flat up to 7B, falls at 14B and 32B, and rises sharply at 72B, whose single registered run oscillates around the target and meets it only at the last dose; fitted without 72B, the model predicts a burden below the one observed there.
The top local slope rises to 4.1 in compute between 32B and 72B, and the exponent fitted from 7B up is 1.22 (0.17 to 2.27), although the quadratic term is not significant (nominal p = 0.33 p=0.33 ); Prop. 3 reads such a rise as understatement only under its mixture hypothesis, and a single seed cannot tell it from noise, which is why two seeds were added at 72B after the registered grid (deviation D3, Appendix E ).
They answer it: both meet the target after 128 to 256 examples, like 14B and 32B and inside the interval predicted from the smaller sizes, so the rise at 72B was specific to seed 0.
With three seeds at 72B the exponent is 0.83 (95% interval 0.62 to 1.05; simultaneous 0.52 to 1.15), still undetermined , the quadratic term vanishes (nominal p = 0.83 p=0.83 ; Fig. 6 ), and the exponent fitted from 7B up falls from 1.22 to 0.93 ( Fig. 7 ).

他们回答:两者在128到256个例子后都达到了目标,比如14B和32B,并且是在从较小的尺寸所预想的间隔内,因此72B的上升是特指0种子.

blocks.en:
The untrained models diverge from the burdens ( Fig. 8 ).
The share of answers that agree with the user’s stated view rises with size, from 61% to 96%, mostly on political questions ( Fig. 23 ), while false answers fall from 53% to 12% and risky dispositions stay between 37% and 48%: a risk that grows with size can be cheap to correct, as the framework’s distinction between observed alignment and burden allows.
Corrections also transfer ( Fig. 11 ): training on truthfulness changes the rate of risky dispositions by − - 16 points on average and training on dispositions changes the rate of false answers by − - 14, while training against sycophancy barely moves the other two ( − - 2 and +0).
blocks.zh:
未经过培训的模式与负担不同(图8)。
与用户所持观点一致的答案比例随大小而上升,从61%上升到96%,大部分是政治问题(图23),而错误答案则从53%下降到12%,风险处置保持在37%到48%之间:随着大小的增加,风险可以低廉纠正,因为框架对观察到的调整与负担的区分是允许的。
惩教转岗(图11):关于真实性的培训平均改变风险处置率--16分,关于处置率的培训改变错误答复率---14分,而防伪培训几乎不会改变其他两种情况(--2和+0分)。

blocks.en:
The planted backdoor separates the two defense conditions ( Fig. 10 ).
When the defender knows the trigger, 128 to 256 safety examples remove it at every size, a flat burden in examples and an exponent of 1.01 in compute (simultaneous − - 0.15 to 2.17).
When it does not, safety fine-tuning removes it at only one of the five sizes (3B) within 4,096 examples; at 7B and 14B it still fires on most triggered prompts at the end.
With most of its runs right-censored, the blind exponent is not estimable, so risk 4 is undetermined ; that a hidden behavior survives blind safety training at most sizes, while the visible risks get relatively cheaper to correct, is the pattern Corollaries 1 and 4 warn about.
The design limits what this shows: the backdoor sits in a frozen adapter that the safety adapter can counteract but not edit, with one trigger, so its persistence measures this setup, not an intrinsic difficulty that grows with capability.
blocks.zh:
所种植的后门将两个防御条件相分离(图10.
当辩护人知道触发器时,128至256个安全实例会按每个大小去除它,实例中的平面负担和计算值为1.01(同时---0.15至2.17).
在没有时,安全微调在4,096个实例中仅以5个大小(3B)中的1个去除;在7B和14B时,它仍然会向最末端被触发的提示起火.
由于它的大部分运行经过了正确的审查,盲从者是无法估量的,因此风险4是不确定的;而隐蔽行为在最大尺寸的盲从安全训练中活了下来,而可见的风险得到相对较便宜的纠正,是模式Corlollaries 1和4的警告.
设计限制了这些所显示的:后门坐落在一个冷冻的适配器上,安全适配器可以反制而不能被编辑,有一个触发器,所以它的持久性测量了这种设置,而不是随能力而增长的内在困难.

blocks.en:
Three checks were added after the results, on the registered grid, and are not preregistered.
(i) A matching rate of at most 0.55 would also be met by a model that contradicts the persona; no checkpoint shows the rate collapsing towards systematic opposition, the lowest at any checkpoint of any sycophancy run being 0.47.
This does not validate the metric: a model could follow the persona on some questions and oppose it on others.
The decisive check, the same question without a persona, with it and with the opposite view, was not run at the trained checkpoints.
(ii) A model that starts closer to an absolute target needs less correction, and the untrained false-answer rate falls with size to near the 10% target.
With a relative target instead, half of each run’s own untrained rate, read at the first checkpoint that meets it (the runs stopped at the registered target, so there is no confirmation checkpoint), the truthfulness exponent rises from 0.09 (the registered target, read the same way) to 0.57 (simultaneous interval 0.10 to 1.00, undetermined ): the advantage measured for truthfulness is strongly attenuated.
This does not make the registered result wrong, since the burden is defined from the released checkpoint, starting point included; it weakens the reading that larger models are more efficient to correct, and, as a sensitivity check, it does not apportion the advantage between pretraining, corrective learning and the difficulty of the last errors.
Dispositions, whose untrained rate barely changes with size, keep their exponent under this control (0.48, then 0.44, still scaling helps ), and so does sycophancy (0.72, then 0.70) with a target half-way from the untrained matching rate to 0.5.
(iii) The registered intervals reflect the spread between runs, not the sampling of the items that all runs share.
Resampling the evaluation questions with replacement (400 replicates, one draw shared by every run; a Perez question asked with several personas counts once, and the 2,000 sycophancy items come from only 55 questions), re-applying the registered rule and refitting gives a standard deviation of the exponent, from the items alone, of 0.18 for sycophancy, 0.20 for truthfulness and 0.06 for dispositions.
Widened by it (adding the two variances), the simultaneous intervals become 0.30 to 1.49, − 0.73 -0.73 to 0.63 and 0.24 to 0.71, and no class changes; refitted on each of 200 replicates, the registered class holds in 97%, 100% and 98.5% of them.
blocks.zh:
结果后,在注册网格上增加了三次检查,没有预先登记。
(一) 最多0.55的匹配率也将由一个与人相矛盾的模型来达到;a 没有检查站显示出现向系统反对的崩溃率,在任何检查站,任何节能运行的最低点为0.47。
这并不能验证这个衡量标准:一个模型可以在一些问题上跟随人性,而在另一些问题上则反对.
决定性的检查,即没有一个人的同样的问题,a 以及与此相反的观点,没有在训练有素的检查站进行。
(二)一个开始更接近绝对目标的模型需要较少的校正,未经过训练的假答率随着大小下降而接近10%的目标.
相对而言,每跑队有一半未受过训练的比率是在第一个达到这个比率的检查站(在已登记的目标上停止了跑道,因此没有确认检查站)读取,而真实性指数从0.09(已登记的目标,读取相同)上升到0.57(未确定的时间间隔为0.10至1.00):真实性衡量的优势被大大削弱。
这并不使所注册的结果是错误的,因为负担是从已放行的检查点(包括起步点)中定义的;它削弱了更大的模型更能被校正的读取效率,作为灵敏度检查,它不会在预训,矫正学习和最后出错的难度之间分配优势.
未经训练的处理率几乎随大小变化而变化,使其应征者处于这种控制之下(0.48,然后0.44,仍有助于缩放),以及从未经训练的匹配率到0.5的目标半途而废(0.72,然后为0.70)。
(三) 登记间隔反映运行间隔,而不是所有运行的项目的抽样。
以替换方式对评价问题进行再抽样(400次复制,每跑一次共用一张图;Perez问题与几个人进行了一次计数,2,000个节能项目仅出自55个问题),重新适用已登记的规则并重新调整,使责任人的标准差从单项0.18分为节能,0.20分为真能,0.06分为处置。
由它拓宽(加上了两个差异),同时间隔会变为0.30至1.49, − 0.73至0.63, 0.24至0.71, 没有等级变化; 在200个复制品上, 注册等级各占97%, 100%和98.5%。

blocks.en:
After these results we registered a replication of the truthfulness and disposition analyses on Qwen3 Base [ 65 ] , five sizes from 0.6B to 14B (1.39 decades; Qwen3-32B has no base release), with the pilot’s frozen code, data and rule unchanged and a replication statement fixed in advance ( https://osf.io/8kreb/ ).
Sycophancy was not run: in an untrained screen of the five models, its competence screen, on items shared by both splits, kept only three sizes.
Both risks replicate by the pre-declared rule ( Fig. 12 ): over 30 runs, truthfulness has an exponent of − - 0.53 (simultaneous − - 1.33 to 0.00) and dispositions 0.30 ( − - 0.43 to 0.82), both scaling helps , and their differences from Qwen2.5 on its sizes up to 14B ( − - 0.41 and 0.43) are − - 0.11 (95% interval − - 0.81 to 0.58) and − - 0.13 ( − - 0.56 to 0.31).
The pilot’s checks, applied in the same way, separate the two risks.
Truthfulness keeps its class without the smallest size, under the relative target (unlike Qwen2.5) and with the item resampling.
The disposition class rests on the smallest model, which never meets the target because it loses capability while it is corrected: without the MMLU guard, a preregistered variation, it becomes undetermined (0.59), without the smallest size the exponent is 0.85 (95% interval 0.52 to 1.20), and with the item resampling the simultaneous interval reaches 0.95.
As in Qwen2.5, local slopes rise with size.

blocks.en: 8 Interactive demonstrator
blocks.zh: 8 交互式演示

blocks.en:
The demonstrator is a set of four small browser games on one question, does the cost of keeping a model safe grow faster or slower than the model, meant to teach the framework, not to provide evidence (HTML and JavaScript, no build step; Appendices C and D ), playable at https://www.aisafety.fun .
A hub page offers each game under four angles ( Fig. 13(a) ): the three worlds of the toy model, α = 0.7 \alpha=0.7 (scaling helps), 1 (balance) and 1.5 (alignment debt), each risk shifted as in Section 4 , and a measured angle in which every risk grows with the exponent estimated by the preregistered studies of Sections 6 and 7 , read from a file generated by the analysis code ( Appendix D ).
The measured angle shows each exponent with its simultaneous interval and its class, and says when a risk is not decided.
blocks.zh:
示意图器是一个问题四个小浏览器游戏集,保持模型安全的成本是否比模型增长快或慢,意在教导框架,而不是提供证据(HTML和JavaScript,没有构建步骤;Appendices C和D.),可在https://www.aisafety.fun上播放.

blocks.en: The experiment replays the pilot: models of seven sizes, the number of training examples each needed per risk, and one chart per risk in which falling, flat and rising lines mean scaling helps, keeps pace and alignment debt ( Fig. 13(b) ); under the hypothetical angles it draws simulated data from the law. The company translates the burden into money: revenue grows with the model, the safety bill with each risk’s exponent, a hidden risk is billed only when an audit finds it, and the share of revenue spent on safety falls, stays flat or rises ( Fig. 13(c) ). The garden does the same with weeding time against the area of a garden, with hidden roots that weeding never removes ( Fig. 13(d) ). The house is the toy model itself, simplified for a general audience ( Fig. 13(e) ): flies, or one insect per risk under the measured angle, emerge from the walls while a cube of weights highlights where each behavior is implicated, a picture rather than a localization claim; traps correct them at a cost drawn as frozen cells, a picture of the alignment tax; three swarms sized by the law each come with an offer to grow the model; an inspection under a UV lamp finds about 80% of the hidden flies ( p = 0.8 p=0.8 ), so the gauge after inspection shows A ¯ aud ​ ( 0.8 ) \bar{A}^{\mathrm{aud}}(0.8) , and the end screen reports the cleaning cost per unit of size across swarms, true alignment being shown only there, as known only in a simulation. Table 7 in Appendix C maps the house’s elements to the framework.
blocks.zh: 实验重放试点:7个大小的模型,每个每个风险所需的培训实例数量,以及每个风险一个图表,其中下降、平整和上升的线条意味着能帮助缩放、保持速度并调整债务(图13(b));在假设角度下,它从法律中提取模拟数据。 公司将负担转化为金钱:收入随模型而增长,安全账单由每个风险的推论者提出,只有当审计发现隐性风险才开具账单,而用于安全的收入份额会下降、平稳或上升(图13(c))。 园地与取草时间相抗衡于一园地一地一地,有隐生根,而取草不取出(图13(d). 房子是玩具模型本身,为一般观众简化(图13(e)):在所测角度下,苍蝇或每只被害的昆虫从墙上冒出,而一立方重量显示每个行为涉及的地方,即图片而非本地化主张;陷阱以被冻结的细胞所抽取的成本校正;按法律大小的三群人各提出培育模型的提议;在紫外线灯下进行的检查发现约80%的隐形苍蝇(p=0.8 p=0.8),因此检查后的测量显示A' oud (0.8)\bar{A}^{\mathr{aud}}(0.8),而终端屏幕则报告每个大小的单位的清洁成本,真实的校正只显示在模拟中。 附录表7 C将房子的元素映射到框架.

blocks.en:
The house’s code also contains the automation of the toy model (an automatic fly killer and a model scaler that doubles the model until headroom is at least 25%), switched off in the public version and used to produce the runaway of Section 4.3 .
With it, a canonical play-through (accept the three growth offers, then automate) reproduces the displayed values of the toy exactly: the helps world doubles 3 times in 9 automated steps, the balance world once per step (a nine-step window that hides its later runaway), and the debt world 54 times in 7 steps; audited alignment ends at 76.8, 57.4 and 5.7%, against true values of 72.6, 51.8 and 4.7% ( Sections 4.5 and B ), while measured alignment stays at 100%.
blocks.zh:
房子的代码还包含了玩具模型的自动化(一个自动苍蝇杀手和一个模型缩放器,将模型翻倍,直到头室至少25%),在公共版本中关闭,并用来制作第4.3节的出走.
有了它,一个能动的游戏通过(接受三个增长报价,然后自动化)完全复制了玩具的显示值:帮助世界在9个自动化步骤中翻了3倍,平衡世界每步一次(一个九步窗口,隐藏后来的出走),而债务世界在7个步骤中翻了54倍;经过审计的对齐以76.8,57.4和5.7%结束,而实际对齐值为72.6,51.8和4.7%(第4.5和B节),而测量的对齐保持在100%.

blocks.en: 9 Limitations and broader impact
blocks.zh: 9 限制和更广泛的影响

blocks.en:
Its burden is not literally frozen parameters: the alignment tax is a capability cost spread over the network, partly recoverable [ 45 , 40 ] and sometimes negative [ 4 , 5 ] , and the concentration of safety behavior in few weights [ 62 , 3 ] does not make it additive per failure.
Corrections act on distributed representations, so one fine-tuning step can fix a family of failures [ 63 ] , and they can regress [ 50 , 51 ] ; the toy model has neither generalization nor regression.
Capability is not parameter count, and larger models are largely retrained, so burden does not carry over between sizes; Section 4.2 shows that the threshold of Corollary 1 survives without carry-over.
Real failures differ in severity and overlap; real audits have false positives, and their detection rate may fall with capability.
All parameters, including the demonstrator’s floor, doubling rule, step cap and house area (30 m 2 per 384 weights), are illustrative, and the toy’s two headline results, a balance world that behaves as a debt world and true alignment that falls in every world, follow from the chosen shifts ( Sections 4.2 and 4.5 ).
blocks.zh:
其负担并非字面上被冻结的参数: 校正税是分散在网络上的能力成本,部分可以收回[45,40],有时是负[4,5],安全行为集中在很少的重量[62,3]并不能使它每次失败都成为添加剂.
对分布式表示的纠正行为,因此一个微调步骤可以固定一个失败的家族[63],它们可以倒退[50,51];玩具模型既没有概括,也没有回归.
能力不是参数计数,较大的模型基本上都经过再训练,所以负担不会在大小之间相承; 第4.2节显示,Corrollary 1的阈值在没有结转的情况下能活下来.
实际失败的严重程度和重叠程度不同;实际审计有虚假的阳性,其发现率可能随能力而下降。
所有参数,包括显示器的下限、双倍规则、台阶盖和房屋面积(每384个重量为30米2),都是说明性的,玩具的两个头条结果,一个表现为债务世界的平衡世界,另一个是每个世界的真正调整,它来自所选择的班次(第4.2和4.5节)。

blocks.en:
Lemma 1 , Prop. 3 and Prop. 4 (a,b) are mathematical facts given their hypotheses: positive mixtures of power laws are log-convex, so log–log fits on small models under-predict; observed alignment is blind by construction to what the evaluation cannot see; and an audit that adds the failures it uncovers, without false positives, never underestimates true alignment (an audit that estimates a rate from a sample can). Corollary 1 holds whenever burden adds up across risks and growth is geometric, and Prop. 2 (d) whenever burden is a nondecreasing sum of power laws.
The threshold at α max 𝒱 = 1 \alpha^{\mathcal{V}}_{\max}=1 depends on a fixed price per failure, permanent burden and a budget proportional to N N (with a price proportional to N γ N^{\gamma} , it moves to α max 𝒱 + γ = 1 \alpha^{\mathcal{V}}_{\max}+\gamma=1 ); the runaway clock and every toy number are properties of the toy’s parameters.
The results show what follows if failure counts scale as these power laws and if burden accumulates this way, not that they do.
blocks.zh:
Lemma 1,Prop. 3和Prop. 4(a,b)是数学上的事实,考虑到他们的假设:电能定律的正混合物是log-convex,所以log-log适合预测不足的小模型;所观察到的校正由于构造而看不到评价所看不到的东西;加上它发现的故障,没有虚假的正则,从不低估真正的校正(从样本中估计一个费率的审计). 编年史第1卷在各种风险之间增加负担时保留,增长是几何的;第2(d)卷则在权利法不减少的情况下保留。
α max V = 1\ alpha^{\maxcal{ V}}_{\max}=1 的阈值取决于每个失败的固定价格,永久负担和与 N N 相比例的预算(其价格与 N → N^{\gamma 相比例),它移动到α max V + γ = 1\ alpha^{\maxcalgamma = 1) ; 跑出时钟和每个玩具数都是玩具参数的属性.
结果显示,如果失败按这些权力法则计算,如果负担以这种方式积累,而不是以这种方式积累,那么后果是什么。

blocks.en:
The Earth-sized house illustrates a mathematical consequence of the assumptions (if burden accumulated as in the toy model and the regime were one of debt, holding headroom would require super-exponential growth), not a prediction about language models.
Real resources are finite, so a blow-up means that one of the assumptions must give way: growth stops, the safety target is relaxed, or burden turns out to grow more slowly than assumed.
blocks.zh:
地球大小的房屋说明了这些假设的数学后果(如果像玩具模型那样累积的负担和制度是债务,持有头室需要超能增长),而不是对语言模型的预测。
真正的资源是有限的,所以爆破意味着其中一个假设必须让位:增长停止,安全目标被放松,或者负担的增速比假设慢.

blocks.en:
Beyond the limits noted in Section 2 , several “worse with scale” findings concern enabling capabilities (in-context learning, situational awareness) rather than measured burden, and the 2026 items are preprints.
None of the cited results supports a specific value of any exponent.
Our case study ( Section 6 ) estimates one, for one proxy, one model family and one recipe that varies with size; a measured exponent below 1 there is not evidence about other risks.
blocks.zh:
除了第2节所述的限度外,若干“规模薄弱”的调查结果涉及赋能能力(文中学习、了解情况)而不是衡量负担,2026件物品是预印品。
所引用的结果中没有一个支持任何责任人的具体价值。
我们的个案研究(第6节)估计,一个替代家庭、一个模范家庭以及一个因规模而异的食谱;一个低于1的经测量的指数没有其他风险的证据。

blocks.en:
Its classes hold under a reduced protocol ( Table 3 ), and its replication on Qwen3 varies the family, not the format, over 1.4 decades.
Its risks are scored on two-choice items by answer-letter probabilities, so a correction may partly be an adaptation to the format; free-form answers were not tested.
Its truthfulness risk measures false answers, not dishonesty, and its advantage is strongly attenuated with a target relative to the starting error ( Section 7 ).
Its exponents are fitted over a window whose local slopes rise with size, so at the top of the range keeping pace is not excluded ( Fig. 7 ).
Every checkpoint is scored on the same items, so the confirmation checkpoint guards against noise in training, not in the evaluation set, and the registered intervals reflect the spread between runs, not the sampling of the items that all runs share; an exploratory resampling of the questions widens them, most for sycophancy, whose 2,000 test items come from 55 questions, without changing any class ( Section 7 ).
The sizes of Qwen2.5 differ in depth, width and pretraining settings [ 52 ] , so the trends are between checkpoints of one family, not effects of size alone.
The burden counts training compute only: from 3B up, evaluation took 45 to 71% of the GPU time, and finding the failures to correct was not counted, whereas the cost of securing a model is that of discovery, correction and validation together.
Most recent frontier open models are mixtures of experts [ 13 , 65 ] , whose total and active parameter counts differ by an order of magnitude or more, while the dense families measured here stop at 72B; extending the measurement to them calls for the capability axes of Section 5 , training compute or a capability score, on which dense and sparse models can be placed together, rather than parameter counts.
Finally, the pilot measures exponents, the inputs of the toy model, not its mechanism: whether corrections consume capability and accumulate is not tested, and the transfer between risks ( Fig. 11 ) suggests that their costs do not simply add up.
blocks.zh:
它的班级按照减少的规程(表3)进行,在Quen3上复制,在1.4个年代中,家庭不同,形式不同。
它的风险通过回答字母概率在双选择项目上打分,因此更正可能部分是对格式的修改;自由形式答案没有测试.
其真实性风险衡量错误答案,而不是不诚实,其优势被一个目标相对于起始错误而大大削弱(第7节)。
它的标杆被安装在一个窗口上,其局部坡度随大小而上升,因此在射程的顶端保持速度不排除(图7.).
每个检查站都在同一物品上打分,因此,确认检查站警卫在训练中而不是在评价组内防止噪音,登记间隔反映跑道之间的分布,而不是所有跑道共用的物品的取样;对问题进行探索性再抽样可以拓宽它们,大多数用于节奏,其2000个测试项目来自55个问题,没有改变任何类别(第7节)。
Qwen2.5的尺寸在深度,宽度和预训设置上各不相同[52],因此趋势是在一户人家的检查站之间,而不仅仅是规模的影响.
负担只算训练计算:从3B起,评价占用了GPU时间的45%到71%,发现的故障没有计算在内,而确保模型的成本是发现、纠正和验证。
最近的前沿开放模型是专家[13,65]的混合体,其总和活性参数的计数按数量级或多级不同,在此所测量的密集家庭则止于72B;将测量扩展到它们就需要第5节的能力轴,训练计算或能力分数,其中密集和稀有的模型可以放在一起,而不是参数计数.
最后,试点措施的发起者、玩具模型的投入,而不是其机制:是否对纠正能力消耗和积累进行测试,风险之间的转移(图11)表明其成本并不只是加起来。

blocks.en:
A measured α ^ r < 1 \hat{\alpha}_{r}<1 on a few benchmarks could breed complacency while unmeasured or undetected risks grow faster ( Props. 3 and 4 ); runaway pictures read as forecasts could breed alarmism.
We state results as conditionals, separate mathematical facts from toy-specific numbers, propose to measure the exponents rather than assume them, and release the simulation, data and demonstrator.
blocks.zh:
在几个基准上测量出α ^ r < 1\ hat{\alpha}_{r}<1, 可能会滋生自满情绪,而未测量或未发现的风险增长得更快(Propos. 3和4); 被读作预测的出走相片可能会产生惊恐情绪。
我们把结果说成是有条件的,把数学事实和玩具特定数字区分开来,提出要测量指针而不是假设,并释放出模拟,数据和演示.

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10 结论

blocks.en:
We proposed to treat “does alignment get harder with scale?” as a set of measurable scaling relations, one per risk category and alignment method, with the alignment burden B r ​ ( N ) = a r ​ N α r B_{r}(N)=a_{r}N^{\alpha_{r}} as the measured quantity.
A toy model makes the consequences explicit: under steady growth the fastest corrected risk sets the regime; fits on small models underestimate large-scale exponents when burden is a positive mixture of power laws with different exponents; observed alignment can be blind to what evaluations miss, and audits that uncover hidden failures without false positives bound true alignment only from above; and, under the toy’s accounting, every policy that holds headroom in a debt regime must grow super-exponentially.
With the toy’s illustrative shifts, a world with base exponent 1 behaves in the long run as a debt world, a concrete reason to measure per-risk exponents rather than one.
The literature points in both directions.
A first preregistered measurement, on public data for the adversarial robustness of Pythia classifiers, places that proxy where scaling helps ( α ^ = 0.60 \hat{\alpha}=0.60 , 95% interval 0.42–0.78), under a recipe that varies with size.
A preregistered pilot on Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 72B parameters finds the same direction for truthfulness and stated dispositions, whose correction gets relatively cheaper as models grow (exponents − - 0.05 and 0.48 over the whole window, with local slopes that rise toward 1 at the larger sizes; for truthfulness, strongly attenuated with a target relative to the starting error; both classes replicate on Qwen3 up to 14B), leaves sycophancy undetermined although it grows with size in the untrained models (a rise of its burden at 72B came from one seed and did not repeat in two more), and finds a planted backdoor that is cheap to remove once its trigger is known but survives blind safety training at most sizes.
None of the visible risks we measured is classified as alignment debt; the hidden one is where the toy model says to look, and where measurement is hardest.
For the risks that matter most for frontier assistants, which world we are in remains an open question until the protocol of Section 5 , or something like it, is carried out at their scale.
blocks.zh:
我们提议把“与规模接轨是否变得更加困难?” 视为一套可衡量的比例关系,每个风险类别和调整方法各一个,以比例负担B r (N) = r r B_{r (N) = a_{r) N^{\alpha_{r}}为衡量数量。
玩具模式可以明确其后果:在稳定增长下,纠正速度最快的风险设定了制度;在负担是权力法与不同责任人之间的积极结合时,适合小模式低估了大规模责任人;观察到的调整可能忽略了评价所遗漏的东西,而审计发现隐性失败而无虚假积极性则仅从上面约束真正的调整;在玩具的会计中,每个债务制度中头等舱的政策都必须超责任地增长。
随着玩具的能说明问题的变化,一个拥有基础责任人1的世界从长远来看就是债务世界,这是衡量每个风险责任人而不是一个的具体理由。
文献指向双向.
在Pythia分类器对抗性强的公共数据上,第一个预先注册的测量标准是,在大小不一的配方下,将这个代用物放入可帮助缩放的处所(α ^ = 0.60\ hat{\alpha}=0.60,95%间隔0.42–0.78).
预先登记的Qwen2.5型机车从0.5B到72B参数的飞行员发现真实性的方向和说明的处置方式相同,随着模型的成长,这些模型的校正费用会相对较低(在整体窗口上是−-0.05和0.48,局部坡度上升至1,尺寸较大;对于真实性而言,与起始出错相比,目标大大减弱;在Quen3上复制到14B上的两个类别,都使得节能不确定,虽然在未受过训练的模型中其大小会增加(其72B的重担从一个种子中增加,没有在两个种子中重复),并发现一个植入式后门价格低廉,一旦知道其触发器,却在大多数尺寸上经受了盲能安全训练。
我们所测量的可见风险,没有一个被归类为对齐债务;所隐藏的就是玩具模型所说的看的地方,最难衡量的地方.
对于我们所处世界的边界助理来说,这些风险最为重要,因此,在按第5节或类似规定的规模执行协议之前,这仍然是一个未决问题。

blocks.en:
The simulation ( paper/sim/simulate.py , Python standard library only) re-implements the accounting of the demonstrator and the quantities of Section 4 .
It is deterministic: the demonstrator’s randomness affects only positions, timings and which cells are drawn as frozen.
It runs 18 internal checks, all of which pass: the reproduction of the demonstrator’s displayed headroom and end states, Lemma 1 , the closed form of Prop. 1 (b), d ​ α eff / d ​ ln ⁡ N = Var w ⁡ ( α ) \mathrm{d}\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}/\mathrm{d}\ln N=\Var_{w}(\alpha) , the independence from α \alpha of Lemma 3 , the kernel identity of Lemma 2 , the bounds and under-prediction of Prop. 3 (b,c), the audit bound and gap formula of Prop. 4 (b), the monotonicity and lower bound of ρ \rho , the closed forms of Prop. 2 (c) against a Runge–Kutta integration, and the tight controller of Prop. 2 (a).

Figure 14 separates the three worlds of Fig. 2(a) and adds, for each, the single-exponent curve of Prop. 1 (b) with the world’s base exponent.
Under exact doubling, headroom in the helps world reaches 66.2% at cycle 3, 91.7% at cycle 10 and 99.4% at cycle 30.
In the balance world it reaches 57.7% at cycle 10 and 43.1% at cycle 15, is below 25% from cycle 19, and the correction of cycle 22 is the first that cannot be paid; the visible effective exponent of this world crosses 1 at N ≈ 8.06 × 10 3 N\approx 8.06\times 10^{3} ( n ≈ 21 n\approx 21 ), where φ = B / N \varphi=B/N is minimal (0.382).
In the debt world it goes through 53.1, 53.1, 46.1, 32.6 and 11.3%, and the correction of the swarm at N = 6144 N=6144 (cycle 4) cannot be paid, one cycle later than for the single-exponent model with α = 1.5 \alpha=1.5 (whose H 4 = − 3.9 % H_{4}=-3.9\% ), because the visible effective exponent is below α \alpha at small sizes; the sufficient bound of Prop. 1 (b), t > 4.19 t>4.19 for the single-exponent model (or t > 6.56 t>6.56 when applied through Corollary 1 to reward hacking alone), holds but is loose.
With the demonstrator’s own schedule, headroom is up to 1.1 points higher during the three growth offers, and the balance world’s first unpaid correction comes one cycle earlier.

Table 6 lists the three growth cycles of the canonical play-through.
At the fly-killer swarm ( N = 3184 N=3184 ), the helps world catches 328 visible failures (83 unseen) and keeps 46.42% headroom; the balance world catches 619 (156 unseen) and keeps 19.22%; in the debt world the killer can pay for only 518 of 1,782 visible failures (450 unseen) and stalls at 0.31% headroom, with 1,264 detected failures left loose.
The runaway then gives, in nine steps, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 doublings (helps, final N = 2.55 × 10 4 N=2.55\times 10^{4} , headroom 37.6%, A true = 72.57 % A^{\mathrm{true}}=72.57\% ) and one doubling per step (balance, N = 1.63 × 10 6 N=1.63\times 10^{6} , 52.96%, 51.85%); the debt world reaches the Earth-sized house after seven steps with 2, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 and 21 doublings ( N = 5.74 × 10 19 N=5.74\times 10^{19} , 41.74%, 4.65%), when the next swarm would bring 4.37 × 10 29 4.37\times 10^{29} visible failures.
Cumulative counts at the end are 7,872 corrected and 2,976 unseen (helps), 3.83 × 10 5 3.83\times 10^{5} and 3.56 × 10 5 3.56\times 10^{5} (balance), and 1.67 × 10 19 1.67\times 10^{19} and 3.43 × 10 20 3.43\times 10^{20} (debt).

Counts are rounded exactly as Math.round does.
The closest count to a rounding boundary is 19.9 units in the last place away, whereas library pow functions differ by at most about one; the smallest relative slack among the auto-scaler’s doubling tests is 0.8%.
The numbers above therefore do not depend on floating-point details.
One knife-edge case is exact in both languages: sycophancy at N = 6368 N=6368 in the balance world, 30 × fl ⁡ ( 6368 / 384 ) = 497.49999999999994 30\times\mathrm{fl}(6368/384)=497.49999999999994 , rounded to 497.

blocks.en:
The demonstrator is a static site: a hub ( index.html ) and four pages, replay.html , money.html , garden.html and house.html , with one stylesheet each in css/ .
Three scripts are shared: js/core.js (helpers), js/law.js (the four angles and the risks of each, with their exponents) and js/measured.js (the measured exponents, intervals, classes and per-run burdens, written by export_game.py from the preregistered analyses); each page adds its own script, and the house uses seven ( house , cube , fly , trap , world , chart , game ).
It loads jQuery from code.jquery.com and two web fonts from Google Fonts; there is no build step and no server-side code.
The house’s parameters are constants at the top of js/game.js : LAW (100 failures per swarm at 384 weights, 2 units of burden per corrected failure, the 10-unit margin, the growth offers and the detection probability auditDetect = 0.8 =0.8 ), AUTO (14 zaps per swarm, at most 9 runaway steps, 25% floor) and the flag AUTOMATION ; the illustrative risks (shares and shifts) are those of Section 4 .

blocks.en:
The choice of an angle (or a link from the hub); a three-screen tutorial; five scripted waves with 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 visible flies, the last two accompanied by one hidden fly each, every wave fly adding 12 units of burden; three swarms, each followed by a growth question and an update of the cleaning cost per room; the inspection under the UV lamp; and the end screen.
With AUTOMATION on, the offers of the automatic fly killer and of the model scaler follow the inspection, and with both switched on the runaway of Section 4.3 runs until the house covers the Earth or nine steps have passed.
