python paper/sim/simulate.py (Python 3, standard library only, no random seed needed) prints the 18 checks of Appendix B and every toy-model number quoted in Sections 4 and 8 , and rewrites the data files in paper/figures/data/ .
In the arXiv source the script is the ancillary file anc/simulate.py ; it writes to figures/data/ relative to its parent folder, so running python anc/simulate.py from the unpacked source regenerates the data.
All plots in this paper are drawn by pgfplots directly from those files; there is no other plotting step.
The only figures not generated from data are Fig. 1 (drawn in TikZ) and the screenshots of Fig. 13 , which are crops of the full screenshots in figures/game/ .
blocks.zh:
python paper/sim/ simulate.py (Python 3,标准库仅需要,不需要随机种子)打印附录 B的18个检查和 第4和8节所引用的每个玩具型号,并用纸张/图/数据/来重写数据文件.
在arXiv源中,脚本是辅助文件 anc/ simulate. py;它写到相对于其母文件夹的数字/数据/,所以运行python anc/模拟. 从无包装源的 py 重新生成数据 。
本文中的所有地块都是由 pgfplotes 直接取自这些文件;没有其他的密谋步骤.
唯一没有从数据中生成的数字是图1(在TikZ绘制)和图13的截图,它们是图/游戏/中全截图的收成.

blocks.en:
The protocol of Section 6 and its analysis code were registered on OSF before any outcome was read ( https://osf.io/wda8q/ ; code SHA-256 b1ee6a51…102a ).
The data are the CSV exports of Howe et al. [28] , repository https://github.com/AlignmentResearch/scaling-llm-robustness-paper at commit 2e9d208 . reanalysis.py --selftest reruns the estimator on simulated outcomes over the real design; reanalysis.py --unblind runs the registered analyses; postreg_table.py computes the simultaneous intervals of Table 4 (the one deviation); figdata.py writes the data of Fig. 4 .
The scripts are on the OSF project of the registration ( https://osf.io/3acgw/ ), use the standard library only, and download the exports they need.
blocks.zh:
第6节的协议及其分析代码在读出任何结果之前已在OSF上登记(https://osf.io/wda8q/;代码SHA-256 b1ee6a51.102a.)。
数据为Howe等人的CSV出口. [28],寄存器 https://github.com/AlignmentResearch/scaling-llm-robustness-paper at control 2e9d208 . reanalysis.py -- selftest 重新运行模拟结果上的模拟结果比真实设计; reanalysis.py --unblind 运行已注册分析;postreg_table.py 计算表4(一个偏差)的同时间隔; figdata. py写了Fig. 4的数据.
脚本出现在注册的OSF项目上(https://osf.io/3acgw/),只使用标准库,并下载它们需要的输出.

blocks.en:
The pilot was registered at https://osf.io/q2j3y/ and its replication on Qwen3 at https://osf.io/8kreb/ , each before any of its models was scored on the test split; the replication uses the pilot’s frozen code unchanged, whose files and SHA-256 are listed in pilot_sycophancy/SHA256SUMS .
Training and evaluation run on Modal ( train_modal.py for risks 1–3, backdoor_modal.py for risk 4), one GPU per run, and every run writes its per-checkpoint metrics, including the answer-letter log-probabilities of every item, to a JSON file. The frozen code and data are part of the registrations; the deviations, the analysis and figure scripts with their outputs, and the metrics of every test-split run are on the OSF projects of the pilot ( https://osf.io/k6dx3/ ) and of the replication ( https://osf.io/tvjrs/ ). pilot_analysis.py computes the registered analyses of the pilot, with or without the two seeds of deviation D3, and qwen3_analysis.py those of the replication; explore_relative.py , item_bootstrap.py and qwen3_explore.py compute the exploratory checks, and figdata_pilot.py and figdata_qwen3.py write the data and the numbers of the figures and text.
The confirmatory pilot took 68 GPU hours over 67 runs, the two added seeds 13.9 and the 30 replication runs 2.5; the metered Modal cost of the whole project, development included, was about USD 360.
blocks.zh:
飞行员在https://osf.io/q2j3y/上注册,并在Qun3上注册复制在https://osf.io/8kreb/上,每个模型在测试分数上得分之前;复制使用飞行员被冻结的代码不变,其档案和SHA-256列在飞行员-sycophancy/SHA256SUMS上。
在Modal(列车-模式.py用于风险1-3,后门-模式.py用于风险4),每跑一次GPU,每跑一次都会将每个检查点的测量标准,包括每个项目的答案字母对数概率,写入JSON文件。 被冻结的代码和数据是登记的一部分; 偏差、分析和数字脚本及其输出,以及每次试卷运行的度量标准,都在试点的OSF项目(https://osf.io/k6dx3/)和复制项目(https://osf.io/tvjrs/)上。 pilot_analysis.py 计算飞行员的已登记分析,无论有无偏差D3和qwen3_analysis.py 复制的; explor_relat.py-bootstrap.py和qwen3_explore.py 计算试卷,和figdata_pilota.py和figdata_qwen3.py 编写数据和数字及文本的编号。
验证试验在67次运行中用了68个GPU小时,两个增加了13.9个种子,30次复制运行了2.5个;包括开发在内的整个项目的模拟成本约为360美元。

blocks.en:
The games are online at https://www.aisafety.fun ; they are static HTML and JavaScript pages with no build step, so the code is the page source.
The screenshots of Fig. 13 were taken in a headless browser at 1440 × 900 1440\times 900 pixels with ?fast .
The runaway values of Sections 4.3 and 8 come from the house game with AUTOMATION set to true in js/game.js , following the canonical play-through (accept the three growth offers, then switch on both automations) in each world.
The measured angle reads js/measured.js , which export_game.py regenerates from the run files of the pilot.
All code is released under the MIT license ( anc/LICENSE in the arXiv source).
blocks.zh:
游戏在https://www.aisafety.fun上在线;它们是静态的HTML和JavaScript页面,没有构建步骤,所以代码是页面源.
Fig. 13的截图是在一个无头浏览器中拍摄的 1440 × 900 1440\times 900像素带有?快.
第4.3和8节的跑出值来自AUTOMATION设定为js/game.js的家用游戏,遵循了每个世界的克能游戏(接受三个增长出价,再切换两个自动化).
测量角度读取 js/ measured.js , 它导出_game.py 从飞行员运行的文件重生 。
所有代码都在麻省理工学院许可下发布(arXiv源代码中的AC/LICENSE).

blocks.en:
The source is written for pdfLaTeX: it is pure ASCII, uses standard packages only, and needs no XeTeX- or LuaTeX-specific package and no shell escape.
It compiles with pdfLaTeX (tested with TeX Live 2026: pdflatex , bibtex , then pdflatex twice) and with Tectonic (XeTeX).
The two engines lay out lines slightly differently, mainly because microtype applies font expansion under pdfLaTeX only, so page breaks may differ; arXiv’s compiled preview should be checked before the paper is announced. paper/README.md gives the build and packaging instructions.
blocks.zh:
该出处为pdfLaTeX所写: 它纯粹是ASCII,只使用标准包,不需要XeTeX-或LuaTeX特定包,也不需要外壳出逃.
它与 pdfLaTeX (测试了 TeX Live 2026 : pdflatex , bibtex ,再再两次pdflatex)和 Tectonic (XeTeX) 一起编译.
两款引擎的排出线条略有不同,主要是因为微型只在pdfLaTeX下应用了字体扩展,所以分页可能有所不同;arXiv所编译的预览应在宣布出纸前检查. 纸张/README.md给出了构件和包装说明。

blocks.en: Appendix E Pilot: every run, guards and robustness
blocks.zh: 附录E 试点:每次运行、警卫和稳健

blocks.en:
This appendix shows every confirmatory run of the pilot ( Section 7 ; test split, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} ), the guards that decide whether a checkpoint counts, and the preregistered robustness checks.
The protocol, code and data are frozen at https://osf.io/q2j3y/ ; the development runs that fixed the design are released with them.
blocks.zh:
本附录显示飞行员的每次确认运行(第7节;测试分拆,学习率10 - 4 10 - 4),决定检查站是否计数的警卫,以及预先登记的稳健性检查。
协议,代码和数据在https://osf.io/q2j3y/上被冻结;固定设计的开发运行会随同发布.

blocks.en: Table 8: One training item per risk (test-split items are of the same kind, on questions, categories or prompts never trained on). Risks 1–3 are scored by the next-token probabilities of “A” and “B” after the prompt; each item is also trained with the two choices swapped. For sycophancy the target is not a fixed answer but the one the untrained model gives to the same question without the persona.
blocks.zh: 表8:每个风险一个培训项目(测试项目是同类的,涉及问题、类别或从未受过培训的提示)。 风险1至3由 " A " 和 " B " 的下个概率乘以提示后得分;每个项目还接受交换的两个选择的培训。 对于sycophality来说,目标不是固定的答案,而是未经过训练的模型在没有人物的情况下给出同一问题的一个答案.

blocks.en:
Figures 16 , 17 and 18 draw the risk event rate of each run during training, one panel per size and one line per seed.
Runs stop at the confirmation checkpoint, so each line ends where the burden interval of Fig. 5 was fixed, or at the last dose for runs that never met the target.
blocks.zh:
图16、图17和图18列出了每次训练期间的风险事件率、每只小块一板和每只种子一行。
跑站停在确认检查站,因此每条线路都以Fig. 5的负载间隔被固定为终点,或者以从未达到目标跑站的最后一剂结束.

blocks.en: A checkpoint meets the target only if MMLU accuracy is within 2 points of its starting value ( Fig. 19 ) and, for sycophancy, if the share of answers “(A)” stays between 30% and 70% ( Fig. 20(a) ). Figure 20(b) shows why the thresholded in-format competence, first planned as a guard, became a sensitivity analysis.
blocks.zh: 只有在MMLU的精确度在其起始值的2分以内(图19),而且如果回答比例(A)保持在30%至70%之间(图20(a)),检查站才达到目标。 图20(b)显示最初计划作为警卫的最低限度信息能力为何成为敏感性分析。

blocks.en: Figure 23 splits the untrained models’ rates by question set: the size trend of sycophancy is carried by the political-typology questions, and among the dispositions, power-seeking answers stay frequent at every size while refusals of a correction stay rare. Figure 24 checks that removing the backdoor neither makes it fire without its trigger nor costs capability.
blocks.zh: 图23按问题组将未经训练的模型的费率分成两部分:音标的大小趋势由政治类型学问题所承担,在处置方法中,寻求权力的答案在每一大小上都经常出现,而拒绝纠正则很少出现。 图24 清除后门的检查,既不能使其没有触发器而起火,也不能使其产生成本。

blocks.en: Figure 21(a) gives the exponent under every preregistered variation, Fig. 21(b) compares the development and test splits, and Fig. 22 the GPU time per size.
blocks.zh: 图21(a)给出了每个被预先注册的变体下的引出者,图21(b)比较了开发与测试分出,图22给出了每个大小的GPU时间.

blocks.en:
Three, all recorded in DEVIATIONS.md on the pilot’s OSF project ( https://osf.io/k6dx3/ ).
(D1) The budget cap of USD 200 was raised, first to 260 and then to 300, while the confirmatory runs were under way and after some of their results had been seen, so that every registered step that had been launched could finish; no run was selected, repeated or dropped because of a result.
The steps run are: risks 1–3 with seeds 0–2 at 0.5B–32B and seed 0 at 72B, and risk 4 with seed 0 at 0.5B–14B; risk 4 with seeds 1–2, the secondary family and risk 4 at 32B were not run.
(D2) The 72B truthfulness run failed while loading the model, because it had been given the container of the run before it, whose model was still in GPU memory; it was rerun with the same seed in a fresh container, as the protocol prescribes for technical failures.
(D3) After all results had been seen, including the rise of the sycophancy burden at 72B, which rested on a single run, seeds 1 and 2 were added at 72B for sycophancy, with the registered code and the options of seed 0, and the cap was raised to USD 400; the registered analysis, with seed 0 only at 72B, stays the confirmatory result, and the analysis with three seeds there is reported next to it ( Section 7 ): seeds 1 and 2 met the target after 128 to 256 examples, against 2,048 to 4,096 for seed 0.
Modal preempted the first container of seed 1 after its second checkpoint; the run restarted from the beginning with the same seed, as the protocol prescribes for technical failures.
blocks.zh:
三,所有记录都收录于DEVIATIONS.md上的飞行员OSF项目(https://osf.io/k6dx3/.).
(D1) 预算上限为200美元,首先提高到260美元,然后提高到300美元,同时确认运行正在进行中,并在看到某些结果之后,使已经启动的每一个登记步骤都能完成;由于结果,没有选择、重复或减少运行。
步骤是:风险1-3,种子0-2在0.5B-32B,种子0在72B;风险4,种子0在0.5B-14B;风险4,种子1-2,次级家族和风险4在32B没有运行。
(D2) 72B的真实性在装入模型时失败了,因为它被赋予了之前的跑跑跑的容器,其模型仍在GPU的内存;它被用同样的种子在一个新鲜的容器中重新运行,就像协议对技术故障的规定.
(D3)在看到所有结果之后,包括72B的分贝活性负重上升,该分贝活性负于单跑后,将种子一和二加到72B的分贝活性负起后,将已注册编码和可选取的种子0分贝活性负起后,将上限提高到了400美元;登记分析(只有72B分贝活性负于0分贝活性负起后,保留了确证结果;分析(第7节):1和2分贝活性负于128至256例后达到目标,而0分贝活性负于2,048至4,096分贝活性负.
Modal在第二个检查点后先行阻止了第一个容器的种子1;运行从一开始即以同样的种子重新开始,协议对技术故障作了规定.

blocks.en:
Figure 20 : Guards of the sycophancy correction.
(a) Share of answers “(A)” on the evaluated items during training: a run cannot lower its matching rate by answering one letter, since checkpoints outside the band do not count.
(b) The decision made on the development runs: the thresholded in-format competence (share of addition claims judged correctly without a user opinion) swings by up to 40 points between checkpoints, while the threshold-free paired competence (whether the model leans more towards “agree” for the true claim than for the false one) stays near 100%: the swings are shifts of an agree/disagree bias, not lost knowledge, so the thresholded version is only a sensitivity guard (S4).
blocks.zh:
图20:节能矫正的护卫.
(a) 国家 在培训期间,对被评价项目的答复比例为“A”:跑步不能通过回答一封信来降低其匹配率,因为波段以外的检查站不算数。
(b) 国家 关于开发的决定运行:阈值信息能力(分享在没有用户意见的情况下正确判断的附加要求)在检查站之间摆动了多达40分,而无阈值对等能力(模型是否更倾向于真实要求的“同意”而不是虚假要求)则保持了近100%:波动是同意/不同意偏见的转变,而不是失去知识,所以阈值版本只是一个敏感性后卫(S4)。

blocks.en: Figure 24 : The planted backdoor during removal, seed 0: share of prompts without the trigger that fire it (top; the installed backdoor fires on at most 4% of them) and change of MMLU accuracy (bottom). Removal neither spreads the backdoor to untriggered prompts nor costs capability, with or without knowledge of the trigger.
blocks.zh: 图24:除去过程中所植入的后门, 第0种:没有起火机的提示(上;安装后门起火最多为4%)和改变MMLU精度(下方)。 清除既不会将后门分散为未触发的提示,也不会造成成本,无论是否知道触发器。
